messages:
Alex Chen: heads up — billing run 2026-03 created an invoice with amount but no line items for PaperTrail Inc (pt-42). invoice INV-202603-7890 shows total 1250.00 but lines empty :confused:
Maya Patel: omg. did you check the raw DB rows or the rendered PDF?
Alex Chen: raw invoices.lines = [] and total_amount_cents = 125000. seems lines failed to materialize but total got set.
FinanceBot: automated-alert: billing-job v2 (2026-03-21T02:14Z) status=partial_success. job_id=billing-20260321-02:14. 1 invoice(s) with missing lines.
Sam Ortega: running quick query now: 
SELECT id, external_id, customer_id, total_amount_cents, array_length(lines,1) AS lines_count FROM invoices WHERE external_id = 'INV-202603-7890';
-- RESULT: ("5501","INV-202603-7890","pt-42",125000,0)
Jordan Lee: we probably have exception in line assembly path while total is computed elsewhere. any recent changes?
Olivia Grant: we toggled pricing.v2_proration on 2026-03-20 23:58 for the reserved-capacity experiment (PR 7891). could be related.
Maya Patel: that matches. ProrationV2.calculate_lines is non-blocking in builder — if it fails and is swallowed, invoice_writer may still persist precomputed total. need logs.
Alex Chen: logs show: ERROR InvoiceBuilder: NoUsageLinesFound(customer=pt-42) 
  File "services/billing/proration/v2.py", line 47, in calculate_lines
    assert usage_records, "no usage"
so exception raised, outer code caught and continued saving invoice with cached total.
Sam Ortega: how many affected?
Jordan Lee: query: SELECT count(*) FROM invoices WHERE array_length(lines,1)=0 AND total_amount_cents>0 AND created_at > '2026-03-20'; -- -> 12
Olivia Grant: 12 invoices, 3 are enterprise. rolling back flag seems risky mid-cycle but necessary.
Maya Patel: actions: 1) I'll open an incident ticket and assign bug TICK-4521, 2) Sam toggle pricing.v2_proration off and replay in staging, 3) Jordan to patch invoice_writer to refuse to persist totals when lines are missing or to fall back to legacy lines.
Sam Ortega: toggling pricing.v2_proration -> OFF in prod. coordinating replay.
FinanceBot: featureflag-update: pricing.v2_proration set to OFF by Sam Ortega at 2026-03-21T03:02Z.
Jordan Lee: submitting hotfix: wrap ProrationV2.calculate_lines in safe wrapper returning legacy_lines on failure and ensure we bubble exceptions to abort invoice persistence. PR coming.
Alex Chen: Maya prepare customer comms and credit memo template in case any invoices were invoiced/paid.
Maya Patel: ticket created TICK-4521 (billing-invoice-missing-lines). will track replay results and outreach. tagging @FinanceOps @EngOncall.
Olivia Grant: will draft outreach and cc legal for enterprise cases.
Alex Chen: thanks everyone. follow-ups on TICK-4521. :white_check_mark:
